lead_headline: Zero new restaurant leads detected today as tracking system goes quiet for first time in weeks

restaurant.blurb: No new leads today — first quiet day after weeks of steady flow. Active pipeline holds at 172 total (95 openings, 77 closures) awaiting verification across Union Station, RiNo, and Cherry Creek.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications for the seventeenth consecutive day as Colorado's liquor license blackout enters third week of May with no state acknowledgment. The freeze since April 30's 2,144-renewal wave persists — no new filings, status updates, or database activity across all license classes. System remains dark as officials offer no timeline for resolution or root-cause diagnosis. May tracks toward month-end with perfect zero across all metrics and zero departmental transparency.

reputation.blurb: 1 mention yesterday — lone Reddit dating-advice thread citation — drops the 7-day total to 49 across 14 sources, down 4% from last week's 51. Denver Post leads with 12 mentions (24% share), trailed by Facebook (11) and Instagram (10). Friday's single-mention collapse marks the week's quietest day despite stronger midweek pickup. Google News RSS drove 92% of discoveries (45 of 49) as the week closes flat versus prior period. Monthly count advances to 205 with no notable institutional shifts.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled) nudges MTD to +21 (+1.3/day) while 90-day net ticks to +134. Friday's modest gain — all acquisition, zero churn — extends the week's positive run after Thursday's +4 surge. The 7-day window settles at +6 (23 new, 17 canceled), down 40% from last week's +10 as cancellations tripled week-over-week (17 vs 5) despite acquisition climbing 53% (23 vs 15). The last four days averaged +3 net versus the prior three-day stretch that delivered −0.7, showing clear late-week momentum even as elevated churn (2.4/day) pressures the 7-day rate (+0.9/day) to run 31% below MTD pace.
